scenes.headline: How one photo becomes a room you can take apart
scenes.sub: DistScene: a shared voxel grid, then a private one per object
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Diorama! Today: how DistScene turns one photo into a 3D room whose pieces come apart.

scenes.text: Generate the room and every object together in one shared voxel frame, then redraw each object in a cube of its own.
scenes.say: Generate the room and the furniture together, in one shared frame. Then redraw each object in a cube of its own.

steps.say: One photo goes in. The model opens twenty slots: one for the room, the rest for objects.
A frozen object generator with small adapters denoises every slot at once, so slots see each other.
All slots share one coordinate frame, so each object lands where it belongs.
Decode it, and the room and every object come out as separate meshes, already arranged.

scenes.label: across the smallest object, in the shared grid
scenes.say: The catch: the whole scene shares one grid, so the smallest object gets about three voxels across.

steps.say: So each object is cut out and scaled up into a cube of its own.
A refiner redraws it, reading the whole scene and a marker that says which object this is.
Then it goes back with the same scale and shift. The layout never moves.
The same layout, from coarse to fully refined.
Only after refinement do the robot arm's joints and the car's grille resolve.

scenes.title: Why the room gets a slot

left.title: Objects only
items: Nothing says where the wall is
left.say: Earlier feed-forward methods generate the furniture and nothing else.

right.title: Room as a slot
right.say: DistScene generates the room as well, so the furniture has something to land on.

scenes.title: Scene F-score on the MIDI test set
scenes.note: authors' runs, on re-rendered test images
scenes.say: In the authors' own runs, it scores ahead of every baseline they tested.

scenes.text: Give the room its own slot and the furniture has something to land on. Then refine each piece alone.
scenes.say: Give the room its own slot, and the furniture has something to land on. Then refine each piece alone.

recap: Room and objects in one frame
Each object redrawn in its own cube
Separate meshes, a scale and a shift each
scenes.say: To recap: one shared frame, one cube per object, and separate meshes you can move.
